events.title: Democratic opening: electoral democracy index rose 0.29 over 5 years
events.detail: From 0.06 in 1942 to 0.35 in 1947. Derived by detecting a sustained shift of at least 0.2 index points over 5 years; marked at the steepest year of the episode.
events.contested: V-Dem indices are aggregated expert judgements with published uncertainty intervals. A shift of this size is well outside the noise, but the exact year is a property of the detection rule, not a documented event.

events.title: Inflation crossed 50% (reached 50%)
events.detail: Consumer price inflation rose from 10.0% to 50.3%, crossing the 50% threshold.
events.source: derived: World Bank consumer price inflation
events.contested: The 50% line is a convention, not a natural boundary. Official inflation statistics are also among the most manipulated numbers governments publish, so the true figure may be higher than the one recorded here.

events.title: People Power removes Marcos
events.detail: Mass non-violent protest and military defections ended twenty years of Marcos rule; a new constitution followed in 1987 with a single six-year presidential term.
events.contested: Democratic restoration did not produce the growth acceleration many expected, and land reform stalled. Whether that reflects the persistence of oligarchic economic structures or the design of the new institutions is a live argument in Philippine scholarship.
events.refs: ["Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines (1987)"]

events.title: Output collapse: GDP per capita fell 11%
events.detail: Real GDP per capita fell from 3,576 to 3,199 (constant 2015 US$) in a single year.
events.source: derived: World Bank GDP per capita
events.contested: A one-year collapse of this size usually has several causes at once - war, currency crisis, commodity price, or the end of a political order. This marker says it happened; it does not say why.
